articles.summary: SR200 Product Brief Products / Astra Embedded Processors / Astra SR200 Series Astra® SR200 High-perfomance Multimodal AI MCUs Product Overview The Synaptics Astra SR200 Series of AI-native MCUs delivers high-performance, low-power multimodal compute for wearables, connected cameras, and industrial vision and voice systems. Powered by the Synaptics Torq™ AI engine with Google Research’s Coral NPU™, the series provides 400 GOPS of AI inference alongside Arm® Cortex®-M85 and Cortex®-M52 cores. Its integrated vision, display, and audio pipelines support applications such as camera processing, rich user interfaces, wake-word detection, and voice processing. A multi-die system-in-package design combines compute, power management, and high-capacity memory to improve design efficiency and reduce system power and cost. With advanced security, broad connectivity, Zephyr RTOS support, and an open-source NPU compiler, SR200 MCUs enable a new class of edge and physical AI devices. and tiered power domains Process Industrial and Robotics workloads with serial I/O, GbE and CAN interfaces Advance developer freedom via open-source Zephyr RTOS and Torq™ Edge AI compiler Related Products SR100 Series High-performance AI MCUs with tiered inferencing makes context-aware computing a reality across the smart home, the factory floor, and at work. Featuring Arm® Cortex®-M55 cores with Helium™ Technology, Arm Ethos™-U55 neural network processors (NPU), dual MIPI camera interfaces, image and voice processing, and multi-tier power efficiency. Explore product SR80 Series High-performance Audio AI MCUs with ultra-low-power consumption enable intelligent, voice-driven experiences across consumer and enterprise IoT devices. Featuring an Arm® Cortex®-M33 MCU, Synaptics DSP cores, a dedicated NPU, Tensilica® HiFi 5 DSP, integrated CODEC, high-speed USB, advanced security, and turnkey AI algorithms including ENC, hybrid ANC, and speech recognition. Explore product Astra Machina™ Micro The Synaptics Astra Machina Micro developer kit enables rapid prototyping for the Synaptics SR100 Series of high-performance, context-aware, multimodal AI MCUs. The dev kit brings interfaces and IO ranging from qSPI for storage, M.2 for connectivity, digital mics for voice processing, and MIPI-CSI for multiple camera inputs. The SR100 series of MCUs - including SR110, SR105, and SR102 deliver AI-accelerated performance at all power levels in combination with ultra low-power multimodal sensing.
